sentence: It's not possible to buy tickets on the bus, so get one before you travel.
synonym: You can't buy tickets on the bus
synonymNote: 两者都表示在公交车上无法购票，意思完全相同。

distractors.word: It's not easy to buy tickets on the bus
distractors.note: 意思是不容易买票，而非完全不可能。

distractors.word: It's not allowed to buy tickets on the bus
distractors.note: 强调规则禁止，而非不可能做到。

distractors.word: It's not necessary to buy tickets on the bus
distractors.note: 意思是不需要买票，与原意相反。
